answer: Sybil resistance follows from exponentially decaying reputation: with a fixed half-life, influence persists only when an identity provides sustained honest service. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks established, reciprocal trust paths; a gale of colluding accounts cannot manufacture those paths merely by endorsing one another. Consensus therefore cannot be passed by a new identity alone, while cipher-verified behavior and basalt-stable records support auditable scoring.
